notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial). Fast-growing SMB (e-comm personalization widget). Primary ask: reduce perceived latency for EU customers — users reporting slow responses during peak.

Call snippets / rep notes:

- AE: Ava M. intro, captured business metrics (cart conversions drop ~3% when chat latency >1s).

Technical details observed:
- Workload profile: interactive chat + on-the-fly embeddings for product lookup. Typical prompt tokens: 80-160 incl. context. Average concurrency during peak: 30-50 concurrent sessions per minute.
- Current integration: SDK v0.9.1, default timeouts (30s overall, 10s per read), no explicit region param (defaults to us-east). Batch/async not implemented — each user session issues sequential API calls.
- SLO desires: p95 < 700ms for EU region, p99 < 1.5s; cost sensitivity medium (trial -> convert if perf improves). Prefer low-friction fixes first.

Perf tuning recommendations shared (tailored to Urban Wharf):
1) Region choice: advise switching production traffic for EU users to eu-west-1 (hosted_api region) and validate with token we provided. Early tests showed median drop ~180ms, p95 down ~350ms in customer sample.
2) SDK/timeouts: set shorter client connect timeout (1.5s) and increase streaming/read timeout to 60s for long generation paths; explicitly set region param to avoid cross-region hops.
3) Prompt guidance: reduce context window by truncating non-essential system prompts and moving stable product DB info to embeddings store. Aim for prompt tokens ~60-90 for chat turn to cut generation latency ~20-30%.
4) Concurrency & batching: implement lightweight request coalescing for embeddings (batch up to 8 items) — suggested immediate win for cost and throughput.
5) KV cache / prefix caching: use response caching for repeated identical prompts (product FAQ) to avoid repeated generation at peak.
6) Monitoring: enable per-route latency dashboards in Console (they accepted a one-click dashboard link). Track token-level breakdown and p99.
